does: The attack roll of one attacker against one target: takes the target's armour class from eoc::ResistancesComponent.AC, rolls the d20 on the roll manager's stream, lets a GuaranteedChanceRollOutcome boost or the target's DodgeAttackRoll boost replace the result, has the hit decided against the armour class, writes the outcome into the hit's EffectFlags (Hit; Dodge and Miss; Critical; AttackAdvantage or AttackDisadvantage) and appends the roll and the armour class to the hit's ConditionRolls. Answers whether it hit.

evidence.says: GK.Memory.Watch on the host's PlayerSpell roll stream NumRolls (roll manager, Element(+0x8, 1, 0x78, 0x70)) over fair melee attacks pinned at 2 and 15: both d20 draws (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x105AAE3) return through bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x106CE8B of this function; the hit's HitDesc.ConditionRolls[1] read MeleeWeaponAttack, Difficulty 13 = the goblin's Resistances.AC, NaturalRoll 15, Total 20, flags Hit; with GK.Memory.Freeze of the goblin's eoc::ResistancesComponent.AC at 21 the same pinned 15 missed (Dodge|Miss) and Difficulty read 21
The count writes of the PlayerSpell stream in a weapon attack by the player return through bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x106CE8B inside this function, itself called from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x106FE82
The difficulty passed down is the target's armour class and the roll is made through the roll against a difficulty
